name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance (Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority)

summary.oneLiner: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 after you turn 60.
summary.whatIsIt: Atal Pension Yojana helps you save a little now for a guaranteed pension later. If you are between 18 and 40 years old and have a bank account, you can join. You pay a small amount regularly, and after you turn 60, the government pays you a fixed pension every month for life.

benefits.text: Fixed monthly pension for life after age 60, based on how much you contribute

documents.name: Mobile number linked to bank account

howToApply.title: Visit your bank
howToApply.detail: Go to the bank branch or post office where you have your savings account.

howToApply.title: Fill the APY form
howToApply.detail: Give your Aadhaar, mobile number and choose your pension amount.

howToApply.title: Set up auto-debit
howToApply.detail: Your chosen contribution is deducted automatically from your account.

rules.label: Your age is between 18 and 40
rules.sourceQuote: Any citizen of India between 18-40 years of age is eligible to join APY.

rules.label: You have a bank account
rules.sourceQuote: A savings bank account or post office savings bank account is required to join APY.

exclusions.label: Income tax payers
exclusions.sourceQuote: An Income Tax payer shall not be eligible to join APY, with effect from 1st October, 2022.

jargon.meaning: The money you pay regularly into your pension account.
Money taken automatically from your bank account on a fixed date.

documentGaps: The exact contribution amount for each pension slab is not stated here; it depends on your joining age.
